## Activity

During February 2021, North City Eye Clinic recorded 293 captures. Capture activity was maintained across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 293 captures, 6 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.0 per cent. The result indicates that most captured images were suitable for assessment, while the ungradable images remained outside the grading process. The ungradable total and rate are reported against the overall capture activity for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 61 referable results from the activity recorded in February 2021. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 1 day. This measure summarises the central turnaround time for completed grading and should be read alongside the referable result count. Overall, the report records 293 captures, 6 ungradable images, and 61 referable results for North City Eye Clinic.
